description:
Return every active site in this AuditAE workspace: its site_id, domain, brand, name, the competitor domains tracked for it, when it was added, its latest completed citation audit (with a shareable report_url), and its paired WordPress connection.

Billing: free — a read-only lookup; works at a zero balance.

When to call: first, before any tool that takes a site_id (mine_competitor_prompts, find_content_gap, schedule_recheck, explore_llm_mentions, crawl_site, submit_urls…) — use its site_id values, and pass only that site's competitor_domains as competitor_domain. check_brand_citation and get_share_of_voice take a site's domain and brand instead. Pass latest_audit.audit_id to get_audit (free) to see where competitors are cited instead of the brand. Also when the user asks which sites or competitors are tracked.

Returns { sites: [{ site_id, domain, brand, name, competitor_domains, created_at, latest_audit: { audit_id, completed_at, prompt_count, engines, citation_rate (0–1), report_url } | null, wordpress: { wp_site_id, status } | null, google: { search_console, analytics, connect_url? }, briefing: {week_of, headline, open_offers} | null, competitor_hints?: [{domain, answers_checked, cited, named, did_you_mean?, hint}] }], next_step?, suggested_next? }. competitor_hints: tracked competitors no answer cited in 60 days (maybe the wrong domain, e.g. did_you_mean); a hint to raise with the user, never applied. latest_audit is the newest completed audit linked to the site, incl. check_brand_citation / get_share_of_voice runs on its domain. suggested_next: add_site on a listed site if no audit ever ran (starts the starter audit), else a site's citation step. report_url is a public report of that audit to give the user. wp_site_id is the site_id the wp_* tools take. google says whether query_search_console / query_google_analytics will work for the site; when either is false, give the user connect_url (a one-time Google sign-in). An empty list means the workspace has no sites yet: call add_site with the user's domain.
name: list_sites
title: List the workspace's sites, site_ids and competitor domains
